coefficient_format: gzip of four n-word little-endian binary64 arrays: hi real,hi imag,low real,low imag; vertices then all sorted edges; sum words exactly and subtract exact weighted mean/2

backend.solver: splu on full complex Neumann matrix; one exact-residual correction solve
backend.scope: Actual saved two-word state and actual floating output posterior audit, not an all-input IEEE guarantee.
